dsh-telegram-duty is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Telegram duty gateway: phone-message task loop on a dedicated duty session, global approval forwarding with inline approve/reject buttons, telegram_ask choice questions, duty/local toggle with a web duty banner, zh/en messages, zero idle tokens.
